title: lab.escalate
description: Published by the scheduler job `lab-escalation` (every 5 minutes, tick skipped unless pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtext('agrotrace.scheduler.lab-escalation')) succeeds) once per lab test it escalated. The job, in one transaction, selects `lab_tests WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','SAMPLED') AND due_at < now() AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` (isOverdue: now > dueAt), sets status ESCALATED, escalated_at = now(), version + 1, writes audit rows (action `system.labTestEscalate`) and inserts this event per test into `outbox_events` (published after commit by the outbox relay, see envelope). The handler creates notification LAB_OVERDUE for the heads of the lab organization and all inspectors, exactly like notification.dispatch, in one transaction that starts with the processed_events claim (envelope, R56).
